title: Set Up: Seeds on the Move

scenes.tts: You need an old fuzzy sock, long pants, closed shoes, tweezers, and a hand lens.
scenes.narration: You need an old fuzzy sock, long pants, closed shoes, tweezers, and a hand lens.

scenes.tts: Pull the sock over one shoe. Walk slowly along the edge of a weedy patch for three to five minutes. Indoors, an adult uses tweezers to pull off what stuck, and looks for ticks. Count the seeds.
scenes.narration: Pull the sock over one shoe. Walk slowly along the edge of a weedy patch for three to five minutes. Indoors, an adult uses tweezers to pull off what stuck, and looks for ticks. Count the seeds.

scenes.tts: Look for the hooks, spines, or barbs that held on. Then sort the seeds into four piles: flies, floats, sticks, gets eaten. Some seeds fit two piles, and that is fine. Drop one of each kind in water, and check again after ten minutes.
scenes.narration: Look for the hooks, spines, or barbs that held on. Then sort the seeds into four piles: flies, floats, sticks, gets eaten. Some seeds fit two piles, and that is fine. Drop one of each kind in water, and check again after ten minutes.

scenes.tts: Stay within arm's reach outdoors. Never eat wild berries or seeds.

items.text: Stay in arm's reach; never eat berries
